Separate each Sanskrit word at its sandhi and compound junctures into its constituent words in unjoined Devanagari, separated by ' + '. Answer with the split only.

puruṣaśca => puruṣaḥ + ca
padaviṣiṣṭatvābhāvāditičenna => cet + na
punastatrauttāya => punaḥ + tatra + utthāya
yāvadhasya => yāvat + asya
dhanamapi => dhanam + api
